name: Should I replace all my old pipes during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace all my old pipes during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether to replace all old pipes depends on their material and condition. If your home has old galvanized steel or polybutylene pipes, it's often a good idea to replace them during a major remodel. These materials are prone to corrosion, leaks, and reduced water flow, and replacing them proactively can prevent costly damage later. If your pipes are copper and in good condition, replacing only the sections affected by the remodel might be sufficient. A plumber can inspect your existing system and provide an informed recommendation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing old galvanized or polybutylene pipes to prevent future issues. Copper pipes in good condition may only need partial replacement.
